feature: Tool, lens, text style and component menus wear the panel's dropdown
summary: The last system pop-ups in the right hand panel now look like Font and Blending: the Measure tool's Mode and Show, the Crop tool's Aspect, a lens's Does, a saved text style's Font, Size and Weight, and a component's Place, look and choice menus. The Measure tool's Snap has two answers, so it shows both as a segmented control. No panel menu draws the up and down arrows any more.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Walk: Scripts/playtest/tool-and-library-dropdowns-open-on-a-click-walk.json.

try.do: Press M for the Measure tool and look at its section: Mode and Show are dropdowns, Snap is two segments.
Press C for Crop and pick 16:9 from Aspect.
Press K for the Lens tool, drag a lens on the canvas, and pick Greyscale from its Does.
Save a label's type as a style, click its tile in the Library, and change Font, Size and Weight.
Switch the Mac to Light and look at the same style.
Give the Button component a second look, then pick a copy and switch its Variant.
Pick a copy of a component with a choice and switch its Shape, then press Command Z.

evaluate: Does the Measure Tool section now read as the same app as the Text and Appearance sections?
Is Snap clearer as two segments than as a menu, given Edges and centers is a long word for a segment?
Should the Lens's Does, six answers, stay a dropdown, or would you rather see them all?
Do the Library style's Size and Weight, side by side at half width, still read their values in full?
rough: Snap matches the fields mock (comp-fields.html, Select): two options are a segmented control, so Snap shows both answers. The task's list had named it among the dropdowns.
The tool settings capsule over the canvas still shows Snap and Show as system pop-ups with up and down arrows. It is not the panel, so this task left it; the capsule is the canvas's own strip.
A copy's choice menu (Shape) stops a little short of the panel's right edge, where the copy's other rows keep a column for their revert arrow. Matches the Label row under it.
Mixed copies read Mixed on the dropdown's face in the quieter ink, the way Blending does, rather than as an extra row inside the menu. Not seen in a picture in this walk.
